Billing Service

The billing service issues invoices and collects payments for the Acme commerce platform 💰. See Configuration and the installation guide.

Architecture

Configuration

The service reads billing.yaml from its working directory:

currency: EUR
invoice:
  due_days: 30

Start it with:

func main() {
	billing.Run("billing.yaml")
}

Limits

SettingDefault
invoice.due_days30
retry.max5

Warning

Do not run two instances against one ledger.
